verdict.rationale: Pulley documents e-signature collection for SAFEs from board members and investors without a third-party tool (pulley-docs-9), suggesting some e-signature/routing capability exists, but there is no evidence of drafting board consents or stockholder approvals specifically, nor of archiving these documents against the transactions they authorize. Missing for 10: board consent templates/drafting, stockholder approval workflows, and evidence of archival linkage between signed documents and specific transactions.
